note: Files: per_problem.json (t1_right, t1_cap_hit), S3 r4/base_rl-02/out/T1.jsonl (text, gold; fetched to runs/theory-tests/r6-account/s3k/...), day1_3 math500_base_cue-01/rows.jsonl (other = attempt 0 sample 3; E = attempt 0 samples 0-2). Gap = other right (score_v3==1, not cap hit) and B wrong (t1_right not 1 or t1_cap_hit true). Share is bootstrapped over gap problems (n = gap count). refuted_by coded as written: refuted iff rule A fires on at least one of the 500 T1.jsonl texts (not only the gap cap hits); a nonzero share implies this. Rule A is implemented from the recipe text (8,000-char windows at offset 0 and after each '\n' with >= 8,000 chars left, zlib ratio < 0.10 on UTF-8 bytes), not imported. No ambiguity affects R1/R2, so alt_measured is null.

Same cell and rules as k=1. Budget = B is a cap hit (t1_cap_hit true) and rule A does not fire. B's cap flag comes from per_problem.json as the recipe says, not from T1.jsonl cap_hit/finish_reason. Refuted iff share < 0.03 or > 0.22. alt_measured null (R3 does not affect R1/R2).

Same cell as k=1. R3 runs on the T1.jsonl text and gold. N deletes all whitespace (regex \s), then '$', '*', '#', '\left', '\right' in that order, then maps \dfrac/\tfrac to \frac. Lines are text.split('\n'). Main (literal) reading: an answer line is an N(line) containing '\boxed{' or starting with 'Answer:'; the gold counts as stated if an N(line) contains '\boxed{g}' or equals 'Answer:g' / 'Answer:g.'. alt_measured: an N(line) containing 'Answer:' anywhere counts as an answer line, so '**Final Answer:**' becomes 'FinalAnswer:', and the gold counts as stated if such a line ends with 'Answer:g' or 'Answer:g.'. Deleting '\left'/'\right' also cuts '\leftarrow'/'\rightarrow'. This is literal but could misfire. Refuted iff share > 0.11.

Same cell as k=1. Slip = not a cap hit, R3 does not take it, and kB == 3. kB counts E samples 0-2 at attempt 0 (first row per sample) with score_v3==1 and not a cap hit. A missing sample counts as not right. Restart rows (attempt 1-2) are ignored. alt_measured uses the other R3 reading (see k=3), which moves problems between answer-statement and R4-R6. Refuted iff share < 0.10 or > 0.36.
Same as k=4 with kB in {1,2}. Refuted iff share < 0.36 or > 0.68. alt_measured: other R3 reading (k=3).
Same as k=4 with kB == 0. Refuted iff share < 0.03 or > 0.22. alt_measured: other R3 reading (k=3).

Same cell as k=1. Unassigned can only be nonzero if kB falls outside 0-3, which the code makes impossible. Refuted iff share > 0, matching the by-construction claim. alt_measured: other R3 reading (k=3).
